controls.role: Canonical archetype-gate baseline per DECISIONS #205. Stock mind rebuilt with the generic coordination machinery so candidates are judged against a coordinating opponent, not a legacy static one.

controls.artifactPath: arena-bots/arc-relay/stock-mind-v4/bot.wasm (HISTORICAL BYTES — path since rebuilt; recover via git history at the standing-strategy-v1 freeze or rebuild from frozen sources)
